entries.6fa20929887cd9a2: These three companies are not included in a single category and are listed individually under the status of affiliated companies. K's Career Staff Co., Ltd. operates in worker dispatch and provides personnel to the group. K's Denki Technical Support Co., Ltd. runs PC classes and builds a nationwide network for digital PC support visits, and it is entrusted by the company with PC support and PC class operations. K's Career Service Co., Ltd. operates general freight trucking, maintenance of household electrical appliances, electrical construction and other businesses, and it is entrusted by the company with delivery and installation of household electrical appliances. The voting rights ownership in all three companies is 100.0% (as of March 31, 2026). Revenue is not stated because the amounts are not printed separately in the securities report.
entries.81d5740d40a6e8e5: This business sells home appliances such as TVs, refrigerators and washing machines, PCs and their peripherals, and mobile phones through a home appliance mass retailer with multiple stores nationwide. Products are purchased centrally at the head office from domestic home appliance manufacturers, wholesalers and others, and sold to consumers through the stores of the company and 6 subsidiaries and through franchise member stores. The store brand is "K's Denki". The 6 subsidiaries are GIGAS Co., Ltd., Kansai K's Denki Co., Ltd., Big S Co., Ltd., Hokuetsu K's Co., Ltd., Kyushu K's Denki Co., Ltd. and Dencodo Co., Ltd., and the company holds 100.0% of the voting rights in each (as of March 31, 2026). The number of stores at the end of March 2026 was 556 (552 directly managed stores and 4 franchise stores). Sales in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥759,710 million (102.9% of the previous year), and net income was ¥14,317 million. The company cites as reasons for the sales increase that PCs remained strong after the end of support for Windows10, that the mobile phone replacement cycle arrived, and that air conditioners were strong owing to extreme heat and other factors. No segment information is stated; the business is a single category, and sales by business are not printed.
